questions.query: I pay for my own Copilot plan. If I cancel it today, when do my current features stop, and what plan do I move to?
I want to move my personal Copilot subscription down one plan level. Does the lower plan start as soon as I confirm?
Will canceling my personal Copilot plan give me a refund for days left in the current billing cycle?
If I upgrade my personal Copilot plan mid-cycle, when does it start and how is the new plan charge calculated?
Our organization adds a Copilot seat mid-cycle and pays by credit card. How are the added seat charge and access handled?
In our organization, how does unassigning a Copilot seat differ from revoking it, and when does the reduced seat count affect billing?
We disable Copilot for our organization mid-cycle and later reenable it during the same cycle. What happens to access and billing?
I get Copilot free as a verified student. Can I cancel that plan using the usual cancellation flow, and what can I do instead?
Copilot is charging an old personal account that I cannot sign in to or identify. What does this policy say to try, and what help can I request if that fails?
For my personally billed Copilot plan, what will I have after the current cycle ends if I cancel now, and will unused time be refunded?
What is the guaranteed number of hours for GitHub Support to resolve a locked-account Copilot billing cancellation request?
Can I cancel my Copilot plan?
